# Dropdown menu

A menu of actions opened from a button.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Accessible first</span> Every action here looks like a button people can find. Row actions are a secondary button with a word, not a menu. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./button">Button</a></span></p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** More actions than fit, or actions people use now and then.
- **Not when:** Choosing a value for a field (select), or the one main action (a button).

Instead:

- [Select](./select.md): Choosing a value.
- [Context menu](./context-menu.md): The same menu on right-click.

## How Accessible first uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">A menu or dialog</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> A strong border and a dimmed page</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> A shadow only</div></div><div class="cap">The dimmed page makes the dialog obvious.</div></div><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">An action on one row or item</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> Button secondary with a word</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> An icon on its own</div></div><div class="cap">A word says what will happen.</div></div></div>

## Words

- Use common words. Explain any term you must use.
- One idea per sentence. Put the action first.
- Never blame the person.
- Use: Continue, Change, Start, You. Avoid: Invalid, Utilise, Submit, Error code.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Continue
- `content.action.cancel`: Go back
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Start a new application

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Arrows move; Enter runs; Escape closes and returns focus. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] The trigger says it opens a menu and whether it is open. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add dropdown-menu
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Dropdown menu reads 4 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Dropdown menu's tokens to change Dropdown menu alone.
